paite: Huai ni'n inn a kipan Jesu pakhia a, tuipi gei ah atu hi.
heading: Buhchithehpa Gentehna Thu / (Mar 4.1-9; Luk 8.4-8)

paite: Huan akiang ah mipi tampitak ahong kikhawm ua, huchi in long ah atuang a, atu a, mipi tengteng piautak ah adingh uhi.
Gentehna in thu tampi akiang uah agen hi, "Ngai dih ua, buhchithehpa buhchi theh in akuan hi.
Buhchi atheh lai in akhen lamsik ah akia a, vasate'n ane zou uhi.
Akhen suangsilei lak ah akia a, lei asah louh ziak in hong pou pah hi.
Himahleh ni asuah in haivuai in a-om a; zung aneih louh ziak in avuai maimah hi.
Huan akhen loulingnei lak ah akia a, loupa hong pousang a; adepmangta hi.
Akhen lei hoih ah akia a, khenkhat aleh za, khenkhat aleh sawmguk, khenkhatte aleh sawmthum in hong gah uhi.
Kuapeuh bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
Huan nungzuite ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Bangziak a gentehna a thu gen na hia?" achi uhi.
heading: Gentehna Kizatna / (Mar 4.10-12; Luk 8.9,10)

paite: Ama'n adawng a akiang uah, "Van lalgam thuguk noute theih phal ahi a, amau theih zaw phal ahi kei hi.
Kuapeuh anei piak behlap ahi ding a, ahau ding; kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak ahi ding hi.
Huchi ahih ziak in akiang uah gentehna in thu ka gen ahi; 'mu napi in amu kei nak ua, za napi in atheisiam kei nak uh.'
Isai thugenkholh atung uah atung hi; 'Bil in zaw na za ding ua, theih bel na theisiam kei ding uh; muh zaw na mu ding ua, theih bel na thei kei ding uh.

Hiai chite lungtang ananggawpta, abilte uh angong a, amitsi ua, huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza kha ding ua, alungtang un atheisiam ding ua, ahong kik nawn kha ding ua, amau ka na hihdam kha ding,' ana chi hi.
"Nou mitte zaw ahampha hi, amuh ziak in; na bil uh leng ahampha hi, azak ziak in.
Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, zawlnei tampi leh midiktat tampi'n leng na thil muhte uh muh a-ut ua, himahleh amu kei uh; na thilzakte uh zak a-ut ua, himahleh aza kei uhi.
"Huaiziak in buhchithehpa gentehna thu za un.
heading: Buhchithehpa Gentehna Hilhchetna / (Mar 4.13-20; Luk 8.11-15)

paite: Kuapeuh in lalgam thu bil a azak a, atheihsiam keileh migilou hong pai in, alungtang a thehsa alaksak nak hi. Huai tuh lamsik a theh ahi.
Suangsilei a theh bel, thu za a kipaktak a pom bang ahi.
Himahleh amah ah zung a-om kei a, sawt louchik kia a-om a, thu ziak a gimthuakna leh sawina ahong omtak in apuk pah hi.
Huan loulingnei lak a thehte tuh thu za a, himahleh khovel awlmohna leh hauhsakna khemna in thu adep a, gah lou in ahong om hi.
Huan lei hoih tung a theh tuh thu bil a za a, theisiam ahi; huai tuh agah ngei a, khenkhat aleh za, khenkhat aleh sawmguk, khenkhat aleh sawmthum in apung," achi hi.
Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh mi alou a chi hoih thehpa toh teh ahi.
heading: Buhlem Gentehna

paite: Himahleh mi a-ihmut kal in melma ahong pai a, buhlak ah buhlem atheh a, apaimang nawnta hi.
Huan buh hong pou a, ahong vuih in, buhlem leng ahong kilang sam hi.
Huchi in inn neipa sikhate ahong pai ua, akiang ah, Pu, na lou a chi hoih theh lou na hi maw? Buhlemte koi a kipan a hong om ahia? achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, melma in na theh ahi ve," achi hi. Sikhate'n akiang ah ahihleh huaite va lakhawm le ung hoih na sa hia? achi uhi.
Ama'n bel, "sa lou e, buhlem na lakkhawmna lam uah buhtak na botkhawm kha ding uh.
Buh lak dong in poukhawm uheh; buhlak hun chiang in buh atte kiang ah, buhlem lakhawm masa phot unla, hal ding in lomgak un; buhtak pen bel ka buh inn ah seklut un, ka chi ding," achi hi.
Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh mi'n ankam chi tang khat alak a, alou a atheh bang ahi.
heading: Ankam Chi Gentehna / (Mar 4.30-32; Luk 13.18-19)

paite: Huai chi laklak ah aneupen a; himahleh ahong pousang chiang in loupa lak ah alianpen a, sing hong hi a, huchi in tungleng vasate ahong pai ua, ahiang ah agiak uh," achi hi.
Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh numei in silngou anbuang tehna thum lak a abilh a, avek a athoh mateng aphum bang ahi," achi hi.
heading: Silngou Gentehna / (Luk 13.20-21)

paite: Jesu'n mipite kiang ah gentehna in huai tengteng agen a, gentehna lou in akiang uah bangmah agen kei hi.
heading: Gentehna Zatna Ziak / (Mar 4.33-34)

paite: Zawlnei in, "Gentehna in ka kam ka ka ding a, leilung pian tung a kipat thil kisel ka genkhe ding," chi a agen ahong tuntheihna ding in.
Huai lai in mipite apaisan a, inn ah alut a, nungzuite akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Lou a buhlem gentehna thu hon hilhchian in," achi uhi.
heading: Buhlem Gentehna Hilhchetna

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Chi hoih thehpa Mihing Tapa ahi a; lou bel khovel ahi.
Chi hoihte gam tate ahi ua; buhlemte migilou tate ahi.
Melma buhlem thehpa diabol ahi a, buhlak hun khovel tawpna ding ahi; a-atte angelte ahi uhi.
Huchi in buhlemte alakhawm ua mei a ahal bang un khovel tawpna ah a-om ding hi.
Mihing Tapa in angelte asawlkhe ding a, gam a kipan hihkhialsakte leh thil hihkhialte tengteng akhawmkhe ding uh.
Amaute haltuina mei ah apai ding ua, huai lai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding hi.
Huai hun chiang in midiktatte a Pa uh gam ah ni bang in atang ding uhi. Zakna ding a bil nei peuh in za hen!
"Van lalgam tuh lou a gou phumguk bang ahi; mi'n huai mu in, asel nawn a, akipah ziak in aneih tengteng azuak a, huai lou aleita hi.
heading: Gou Phumguk Gentehna

paite: "Huan van-gam tuh sumsinmi tuikepsuang hoihtak zongmi bang ahi nawn hi.
heading: Tuikepsuang Gentehna

paite: Huan ama'n tuikepsuang manphatak khat amu a, aneih tengteng zuak in aleita hi.
"Van lalgam tuh lenpi, tuipi a paih, chi chih tunkhawmna bang ahi nawn hi.
heading: Lenpi Phumguk Gentehna

paite: Adimtak in agei ah akaikhia ua, atu ua, bawm ah ahoih teng alakhawm ua, ahoihloute apaih uh bang ahi.
Khovel tawp hun chiang in huchibang mah in a-om ding, angelte ahong pawt ding ua, midiktatte lak ah migiloute akhenkhe ding uh.
Huchi in haltuina mei ah apai ding ua, huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding," achi hi.
Jesu mah in akiang uah, "Huai tengteng na theisiam uhia?" achi a, amau akiang ah, "Thei e,” achi uhi.
heading: Thil Lui Leh Thil Thak

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huaiziak in laigelhmi van-gam thuhilh a om peuhmah, inn neipa, agoubawm a kipan a thil thakte leh thil luite pholhkhepa bang ahi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai gentehnate agen khit in huai a kipan apaita hi.
heading: Nazaret Jesu Adeih Kei Uh / (Mar 6.1-6; Luk 4.16-30)

paite: A-omna kholam atung a, asinagogte uah amaute thu ahilh a, huchi in lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Hiai mi'n koi a kipan a hiai bang pilna leh hiai nasep thupi hihtheihnate amuh ahia?
Hiai mi singlem bawlpa tapa hilou hia? Anu Mari kichi hilou hia? A-unaute Jakob, Joseph, Simon, Judas kichite hilou uhia?
Hiai mi in koi a kipan a hiaite tengteng mu ahia? Asanggamnute leng i kiang ua om vek hilou uhia?" achi uhi.
Huchi in atung ah alungkim kei uhi. Himahleh Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zawlnei ama kholam leh ama inn lam lou ngal ah pahtawi louh in a-om ngei kei," achi hi.
Agin louh ziak un huai ah nasep thupi dang tam ahih kei hi.
